questions.question: Who won the Gold Mercury Award 2025 for promoting peace and sustainability?

• President Anwar Sadat of Egypt for Middle East peace efforts.
 
• Prof. Robert Gallo for discovering HIV as the cause of AIDS.

questions.question: By how much percentage has the incidence rate of TB declined in India since 2015 as a result of the success of India’s National TB Elimination Program?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**17.7%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The incidence rate of TB in India has dropped by 17.7% since 2015.**
 
• **TB cases notified in 2024 reached a record 26.07 lakh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2015, the TB incidence rate was 237 cases per lakh population.
 
• By 2023, this incidence had decreased to 195 per lakh population.
 
• TB-related deaths have also declined by 21.4% during the same period.
 
• The number of missing TB cases has reduced from 15 lakh in 2015 to 2.5 lakh in 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• National TB Elimination Program (NTEP)__

 __
 
• India aims to eliminate TB by 2025.
 
• Initiatives such as Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana and TB Mukt Bharat Campaign have strengthened TB control efforts.
 
 
 
• Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana__
 __
 
• Provides financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month to TB patients.
 
• Aims to improve nutrition and treatment adherence.
 
 
 
• Innovations in TB Detection and Treatment__
 __
 
• The introduction of mBPaL treatment regimen has improved MDR-TB treatment success rates.
 
• AI-based tools like DeepCXR and handheld X-ray devices are improving TB screening.
 
 
 
• Future Health Targets__
 
 
• India aims to eliminate Leprosy, Lymphatic Filariasis, Measles, Rubella, and Kala-azar in the next five years.
 
• Collaborations with ICMR and private partners are driving progress in disease elimination.

questions.question: Which initiative has the Reserve Bank of India launched to address climate change risks and sustainable finance?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**On Tap Cohort.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is launching a dedicated 'On Tap' cohort on climate change risks and sustainable finance.**
 
• **This initiative will be part of RBI’s Regulatory Sandbox to encourage financial innovations in green finance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'On Tap' cohort aims to support capacity building, ecosystem development, and financing for sustainable projects.
 
• RBI is also planning to conduct a special ‘Greenathon’ focused on climate change and related aspects.
 
• Green finance projects face higher credit risks due to the use of emerging green technologies with limited operational track records.
 
• Priority sector lending in India already supports credit flow to renewable energy and sustainable projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Regulatory Sandbox__

 __
 
• An initiative by RBI to allow fintech startups and financial institutions to test innovative financial solutions under regulatory supervision.
 
• Encourages development in digital payments, lending, and sustainable finance.
 
 
 
• Green Finance Challenges__
 __
 
• Higher credit risk due to new technologies with limited performance history.
 
• Need for technical know-how among financial institutions for risk assessment in green projects.
 
 
 
• Climate Change Risks in Finance__
 __
 
• Impacts financial risks including credit risk, market risk, and operational risk.
 
• Requires coordination among regulators, financial institutions, and government agencies.
 
 
 
• RBI's Role in Sustainable Finance__
 
 
• Facilitates policy and regulatory support for green finance initiatives.
 
• Aims to create a stable financial system resilient to climate-related risks.

questions.question: Which Central Armed Police Force academy has been renamed Rajaditya Cholan (RTC), Thakkolam in memory of the Chola prince Rajaditya?

options.text: Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) Recruits Training Centre

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) Recruits Training Centre.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Recruits Training Centre (RTC) of the CISF in Arakkonam has been renamed *Rajaditya Cholan (RTC), Thakkolam* in honor of the Chola prince Rajaditya.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajaditya Chola, son of Parantaka I, was killed in the Battle of Thakkolam in 949 CE by Ganga prince Butuga, an ally of the Rashtrakutas.**
 
• He was given the title *‘**Yanaimel Thunjiya Devar**’* (The king who died on the back of an elephant) as per Chola inscriptions.
 
• The renaming order was issued by CISF Director General Rajwinder Singh Bhatti on February 24, 2025.
 
• This move honors Rajaditya’s legacy and his role in the Chola dynasty’s military history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)**__

 __
 
• Established in 1969
 
• Provides security to critical infrastructure, including airports, metro networks, and industrial sectors
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi
 
 
 
• **Battle of Thakkolam (949 CE)**__
 __
 
• Fought between the Cholas and Rashtrakutas
 
• Rajaditya Chola was leading the Chola forces
 
• His death led to a temporary setback for the Cholas
 
 
 
• **Other Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs)**__
 
 
• **NSG (National Security Guard):** Special operations unit for counter-terrorism
 
• **ITBP (Indo-Tibetan Border Police):** Secures India’s border with China
 
• **BSF (Border Security Force):** Guards India's borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh

questions.question: Which two states are involved in the development of the Ganga-Narmada Tourism Corridor?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board is working on initiatives to connect the state’s natural, spiritual, and cultural heritage with major religious destinations in Uttar Pradesh, such as Prayagraj, Ayodhya, and Varanasi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board** is working on initiatives to connect the state's **natural, spiritual, and cultural heritage** with major religious destinations in **Uttar Pradesh**, such as **Prayagraj**, **Ayodhya**, and **Varanasi**.

 
 
• 
 
A primary focus is the development of the **Ganga-Narmada Tourism Corridor**, which aims to enhance tourism collaborations between **Madhya Pradesh** and **Uttar Pradesh**.

 
 
• 
 
The goal of the **Ganga-Narmada Tourism Corridor** is to offer visitors a **rich and diverse experience** by linking the cultural and religious significance of both the **Ganga** (Uttar Pradesh) and **Narmada** (Madhya Pradesh) rivers.

 
 
• 
 
This initiative aims to boost **religious tourism**, **cultural exchanges**, and provide new opportunities for **tourism** in both states.

questions.question: What is the estimated total population of river dolphins in India as per the first-ever comprehensive survey?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**6,327**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India’s first-ever comprehensive river dolphin survey estimated presence of 6,327 river dolphins across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **first-ever comprehensive river dolphin survey** in India estimated a total of **6,327 river dolphins** across the country, with **635 dolphins** recorded in **Assam**.
 
• The river dolphin in Assam is called **Khihu**, and the survey was conducted under **Project Dolphin**.
 
• A **male Gangetic Dolphin** was **satellite tagged** in **Kulsi River near Guwahati**, marking a first in India and the world.
 
• **Assam’s Brahmaputra River** remains a stable and **barrier-free** habitat for river dolphins, while other rivers like the **Barak River** and **Subansiri River** show concerning signs of decline or extinction.
 
• The survey indicated that **Assam’s river systems** are critical for dolphin conservation, emphasizing the importance of **local community involvement** and the **protection of critical river habitats**.
